# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

description: Zephyr Emulated ADC controller

compatible: "zephyr,adc-emul"

include: adc-controller.yaml

properties:
  ref-internal-mv:
    type: int
    required: false
    description: Internal reference voltage in millivolts.

  ref-external0-mv:
    type: int
    required: false
    description: External reference 0 voltage in millivolts.

  ref-external1-mv:
    type: int
    required: false
    description: External reference 1 voltage in millivolts.
